text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"NJ","level":"state","category":"application_screening_fees","status":"in_force","title":"NJ residential rental application fee cap ($50, CPI-adjusted)","requirement":"A landlord or agent may not require an application or similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes that exceeds $50. The cap is adjusted each year from January 1 of the year after enactment, in proportion to the 12-month percent change in the CPI (NY-Northern NJ-Long Island, All Urban Consumers) ending October 31 of the prior year. The adjustment is made only if the change is greater than zero. The State Treasurer determines the adjustment by December 1, and the Director of the Division of Consumer Affairs publishes the limit annually.
